name: Delude
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You mask your true alignment from all forms of divination by “borrowing” the alignment aura of one creature within 30 feet of you when you cast this spell. The creature whose alignment you are borrowing retains its original alignment (you are copying it, not stealing it) and must have an Intelligence of 3 or higher or the spell automatically fails. If the spell succeeds, you radiate the exact same alignment as the one you copied for the duration of this spell.
